rows.en: Teach me how to swim again...
rows.notes: Pinon, both genders; continues 'But before that...' (c12302).

rows.en: You got it. Okay, let's practice hard!
Yeahhh!

(I bet Pinon-chan will grow up
into a wonderful woman.)

(Though whether she'll get a knockout body
that beats Sheryl's, I couldn't say...)

(Today I'm going to enjoy a swim in the sea
at the artificial island with Pinon-chan!)

(Pinon-chan still can't swim,
so I'd better give her plenty of support.)
No problem. So, shall we go have some fun?
Huh? I think it suits you, and you look cute.

Hmm, I don't think you've grown up enough yet
to be called sexy...

You don't have to force yourself
to act all grown up, Pinon-chan.

(I see...
Pinon-chan pushed herself so hard
because I treated her like a kid...)

You're you, Pinon-chan, so I don't think
you need to push yourself like that.

You've still got lots of growing to do,
so you'll be like Sheryl in no time.

Besides, you're cute just the way you are,
Pinon-chan.
Hehe, go for it, Pinon-chan.
You got it. Okay, let's practice hard!

(I'm sure Pinon-chan will grow up
into a wonderful woman.)

(I came to the artificial island
with Pinon-chan today, but...)
rows.notes: Player, both genders; frd_pnn_007 later visit.

rows.en:
What's wrong, Pinon-chan? If you're worried
about not being able to swim,
let's practice hard!
No, that's not what's bothering me...
Then what's bothering you?

I just suddenly got worried whether I can
really become a woman with a knockout body
like Sheryl or Nanase...

(That's something nobody can tell
for another few years...)

You drink milk every day and never slack off,
right? Then I'm sure you'll be fine.
No, but still...

We came all the way to the beach,
so let's go have some fun, Pinon-chan.

Hmm... Maybe I should do some research
on how to make my chest grow for sure...

(You're worrying way too much about it,
Pinon-chan...)

(That's something nobody can tell
for another few years...)

You drink milk every day and never slack off,
right? Then I'm sure you'll be fine.

We came all the way to the beach,
so let's go have some fun, Pinon-chan.

(You're worrying way too much about it,
Pinon-chan...)

(Pinon-chan suddenly told me to come
to Central Park... What could she want?)

Thanks for coming,
\p...
So what's going on today?
I really wanted to thank you...
Thank me?

It's a bit late, but thank you for helping me
practice tongue twisters and swimming.
Come on, it's nothing that deserves thanks...

That's not all. You helped me out
in lots of other ways too...

When I was forcing myself to act grown up,
you accepted me just the way I am.
I was really... really happy, you know.
Pinon-chan...
rows.notes: x4, the player, both genders: here and nml_pnn_005 (reaction to Pinon).

rows.en:
If I had a big brother...
I bet he'd be someone like you...

If you'd keep watching over me from now on...
that would... make me happy......

I'll do my best too, and become
such a grown-up woman it'll amaze you.

Go for it, Pinon-chan.
If anyone can do it, it's you.

Phew... I managed to thank you properly,
so I-I'm going home now.
S-see you, then......
......Big Bro.
rows.notes: Pinon, male scene. onii-chan as 'Big Bro' per the brief's kinship rule.

rows.en: Huh? Wha-, Big Bro?!
...Just kidding.
rows.notes: x4: Pinon after 'Big Bro/Sis' here; Michel after greeting the player as a butler in scd_com_716 (both genders).

rows.en:
(Getting called 'Big Bro' out of nowhere
surprised me... but if I had a little sister,
would she be like Pinon-chan?)

(Alright! From now on I've got to do my best
as Pinon-chan's good big brother!)

(Pinon-chan suddenly told me to come
to Central Park... What could she want?)

If I had a big sister...
I bet she'd be someone like you...

Go for it, Pinon-chan.
If anyone can do it, it's you.
......Big Sis.
rows.notes: Pinon, female scene. onee-chan as 'Big Sis', parallel to 'Big Bro' (the brief lists 'Sis' for onee-san).

rows.en: Huh? Wha-, Big Sis?!

(Getting called 'Big Sis' out of nowhere
surprised me... but if I had a little sister,
would she be like Pinon-chan?)

(Alright! From now on I've got to do my best
as Pinon-chan's good big sister!)

(Pinon-chan and I ended up taking
a walk in Central Park today, but...)
rows.notes: Player, both genders; frd_pnn_008 later visit.

rows.en:
You haven't told anyone what you saw here before,
have you? If you've told anyone else...
rows.notes: Pinon, male scene; trailing threat. Refers to the cat scene (frd_pnn_005).

rows.en:
(That was ages ago, and she's still worried
about it... Oh, Pinon-chan...)

Hey, are you even listening to me,
\p?
Of course I'm listening......

Uuu...
\p is bullying me...
rows.notes: Pinon, both genders; reacts to the player's teasing 'Nya~'.

rows.en:
D-don't cry, Pinon-chan!
I'm kidding, just kidding...
Hippo-cow ice cream...

If you treat me to hippo-cow ice cream,
I'll forgive you...
Hehe, then let's go to Folmo.

Huh?!
You'll really treat me?
Yaaaaay!!

(Pinon-chan was so happy about it,
so I guess treating her to ice cream was worth it.)

(Wait, am I maybe the type
who spoils little sisters?)

You haven't told anyone what you saw here before,
have you? If you've told anyone else...

(That was ages ago, and she's still worried
about it... Oh, Pinon-chan...)

D-don't cry, Pinon-chan!
I'm kidding, just kidding...

(Pinon-chan was so happy about it,
so I'm glad I treated her to ice cream.)

uncertain: c12353/c12354/c12356 and c12361/c12362/c12363: onii-chan / onee-chan as 'Big Bro' / 'Big Sis' (kinship rule; the brief gives 'Sis' for onee-san, 'Big Sis' chosen to pair with 'Big Bro').
